en: Black‑and‑white postcard‑style photograph showing a small cargo ship named "ROLAND KRUSE" sailing along a river or canal. The vessel has two masts and a low, elongated hull. On the left bank stands a modernist industrial or harbor building with large windows and a small group of people gathered on the quay. Behind the quay and along the horizon are trees, industrial chimneys, and light smoke, indicating an industrial waterfront landscape.
